|game_text='''0 side — Rebel Strike Team'''

''Deploy Endor system, Back Door, and [Virtual Block 7] [[The Shield Is Down! (V) (Virtual Block 7){{!}}The Shield Is Down!]].'' For remainder of game, your [Episode I] characters and [Virtual Block 3] rifles are lost. Your Force generation is +1 at your Endor sites. May use 1 Force to ▲ an [Endor] Epic Event. While this side up, your Force drains on Endor are -1. Your Bunker gains one [Light Side]. If you occupy Bunker at the end of a battle you just won there, may use your [Endor] Epic Event to attempt to “blow away” Bunker. Flip this card if Bunker “blown away.”

'''7 side — Garrison Destroyed'''

While this side up, [[Endor Shield]] is canceled. May raise your converted Endor to the top. If Establish Secret Base on table, Force generation at Endor locations may not be canceled. At Endor sites you occupy with a scout, your Force drains may not be modified by opponent. Whenever you initiate a battle with a scout, may retrieve 2 Force. Once per game, may ▼ (or deploy from hand) a Rebel starship for half its printed deploy cost (round down).
|hatnote=For the Decipher card, see [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed]].
|versions='''Decipher''' — [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed]] (<code>8_78</code>)<br />'''Virtual Legacy''' — '''this page''' (<code>1273_43</code>)
